verdict.rationale: Receipt issuance is a fair question for a payments/POS product like SumUp, but the evidence pack has no first-party documentation of email, SMS or printed receipts, nor of compliance with card-network receipt requirements. The only receipt-related item is a community developer who built a third-party receipt-printer integration by working around SumUp's public API. That is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can issue digital (email/SMS) or printed receipts that meet card-network requirements
